args.subject: Re: Resume Template Request
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume templates website and a download link, but I'm encountering some restrictions when trying to download the file directly. The website www.resume-templates.com has a download section at www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links, but the direct PDF download link is being blocked by my system's security policies.

I'm currently exploring alternative ways to get the template to you. Would you prefer:
1. I send you a different format template (if available)
2. I provide you with the direct website links so you can download it yourself
3. I try another method to transfer the file

Please let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Best regards,
Emma
